PATH 2010.finalExam: Truly cumulative and in the same format as earlier exams; students with a B+ or higher (87.00 or higher) can opt out and keep their grade, computed over 850 base points instead of 1000.

PATH 2010.attendance: Required; counted in the 75-point participation grade. Students get 3 excused and 3 unexcused absences without penalty, and excused absences must be serious and verifiable.
PATH 2010.lateWork: Assignments are due at the end of class on the due date; talk to the instructor if late, since points can be lost (the amount is not stated).
PATH 2010.makeups: Make-up exams are given for excused absences; email the instructor ahead of a known conflict (or as soon as possible after an emergency), and take the make-up within a week of the scheduled exam.
other: Averages are not rounded up (86.9 stays a B, not a B+).
Arriving late to an exam does not extend the time.
Disrespectful behavior can lower the participation grade.
